mapping_status: Provisional regional mapping; native grades retained. Expert/freeride/unknown remain excluded. Not operator-validated.
coverage_status: Bounded research extract, not whole-resort coverage; OSM map API may include complete ways extending beyond requested bounds.
sanitization: Contributor identity/history and relations omitted; only nodes and all piste/aerialway ways retained; unsupported piste types remain non-routable source evidence. Not original response bytes.
source_hash_semantics: Graph source_sha256 identifies sanitized importer input; original response hash is separate.
